children: P3 Health Partners entered into a financing with affiliates of Chicago Pacific Founders for up to $70 million via Series D-1 19.5% Cumulative Preferred Stock and seven-year warrants, priced at the Nasdaq Minimum Price on issuance. The preferred ranks senior to common equity and is redeemable at $100 per share plus unpaid dividends. In connection, the company agreed to register the resale of warrant shares and updated its governance arrangements, allowing CPF to designate an additional independent director while extending a 49.99% ownership standstill to December 31, 2027. A special committee of independent directors approved the related-party transactions.
